# Generated by gen_help.py from pico/explorer/help_text.h, do not edit.
80 0 H Browsing the lists
80 0 L UP / DOWN       Move the selection; the list moves to the next page by itself.
80 0 L LEFT / RIGHT    Previous / next page of the list.
80 0 L ENTER           Open the entry: a folder, the MP3 player or the ROM screen.
80 0 L SPACE / FIRE    Quick-run the ROM with its saved options; the joystick
80 0 L                 fire button A or B does the same. On a folder it opens it.
80 0 L ESC             Leave the current folder (the same as the .. entry).
80 0 L /               Search: type part of a name, ENTER jumps to a match.
80 0 L C               Switch between 40 and 80 columns on machines that have both.
80 0 L F5              Show this help from any screen.
80 0 H Sources
80 0 L F1  Flash       ROMs kept in the cartridge; no microSD card needed.
80 0 L F2  microSD     Folders, ROM, DSK, MP3 and WAV files of the memory card.
80 0 L F3  FileHunter  Online ROM and disk catalog; needs the ESP-01 WiFi module.
80 0 L F4  WiFi        Set the WiFi network and password; the MSX restarts.
80 0 H Joystick
80 0 L Directions move and change pages; fire button A or B quick-runs. It only works
80 0 L in the flash and microSD lists: everything else needs the keyboard.
80 1 H File commands (F2 microSD list)
80 1 L D   Delete the selected file after a Y/N question; its .PVC options go too.
80 1 L     In the F1 list it removes the selected flash entry. Folders are protected.
80 1 L R   Rename a ROM, DSK image or flash entry. The mapper tag and extension stay.
80 1 L     ENTER confirms, ESC cancels. Long names are limited by the screen width.
80 1 L W   Create a folder in the folder you are browsing, on the current partition.
80 1 L M   Move a file: press M on it, open the destination folder, press M again.
80 1 L     Its .PVC options go along. ESC in the root, F1 or F3 cancel the move.
80 1 L F   Copy the selected ROM into the cartridge flash after a Y/N question.
80 1 L     Flash ROMs run without the card; their options are kept on the card.
80 1 L P   Cycle through the FAT16, FAT32 and exFAT partitions of the card.
80 1 L A   Make the folder you are browsing the File Hunter download folder.
80 1 H Good to know
80 1 L - A ROM larger than 4 MB has to be copied to flash before it can run.
80 1 L - A ROM's options (mapper, audio, PSG...) are saved next to it as NAME.PVC.
80 1 L - A tag in the file name forces the mapper: Knight Mare.PLA-32.ROM.
80 1 L - Only .ROM, 360/720 KB .DSK, .MP3 and .WAV files are listed; folders first.
80 1 L - The bottom line shows the page and the free space of the flash or the card.
80 2 H ROM screen (ENTER on a ROM)
80 2 L UP / DOWN       Choose an option. The last row, Run, starts the ROM.
80 2 L LEFT / RIGHT    Change the value of the chosen option.
80 2 L ENTER / SPACE   Run the ROM (on the Run row).        ESC   Back to the list.
80 2 H Options
80 2 L Mapper    How the cartridge maps the ROM. SD ROMs are detected; change it only
80 2 L           if the game does not start. ASC16X-FR adds FlashROM game saves.
80 2 L Audio     Sound hardware emulated for the game: SCC, SCC+, MSX-MUSIC, Dual
80 2 L           PSG, SFG01/SFG05, SN76489 Franky or an external SCC cartridge.
80 2 L PSG       Yes copies the MSX PSG to the cartridge audio output (DAC).
80 2 L Volume    Level of the cartridge audio output; 100% is the normal level.
80 2 L Freq/CPU  50/60 Hz on MSX2+ and the CPU speed, when the computer allows it.
80 2 L WiFi      Nextor entries only: expose the WiFi BIOS before booting.
80 2 L SD Part   Nextor SD entries only: the FAT16 partition Nextor boots from.
80 2 H Saved options
80 2 L Run saves the options as NAME.PVC next to the ROM (flash: /NAME.flash.PVC).
80 2 L SPACE in the list runs the ROM with those options. Delete the .PVC to reset.
80 2 H Disk images
80 2 L A .DSK image boots through the built-in Nextor; only some options apply to it.
80 3 H MP3 / WAV player (ENTER on an audio file)
80 3 L Plays the file from the microSD card through the cartridge audio output.
80 3 L UP / DOWN       Choose Play/Stop, Pause/Resume or the play mode.
80 3 L ENTER / SPACE   Run the chosen action.
80 3 L LEFT / RIGHT    With the play mode chosen: Single, All or Random.
80 3 L N / P           Next / previous song (All and Random modes, while playing).
80 3 L ESC             Stop the music and go back to the list.
80 3 L C               Switch between 40 and 80 columns.
80 3 H Good to know
80 3 L - Only the elapsed time is shown: the file is streamed, its length is unknown.
80 3 L - In All and Random mode the player goes on to the next song by itself.
80 3 L - The music stops when you leave the player, change source or start a ROM.
80 4 H File Hunter (F3)
80 4 L Online catalog of MSX ROMs and disk images. It needs the ESP-01 WiFi module,
80 4 L set up with F4 (network name and password; the MSX restarts afterwards).
80 4 H Result list
80 4 L UP / DOWN       Move in the results.       LEFT / RIGHT   Change page.
80 4 L ENTER / SPACE   Open the detail screen of the selected ROM or disk.
80 4 L /               Search the catalog; ENTER runs the search, ESC cancels it.
80 4 L T               Switch between the ROM and the DSK catalog (keeps the search).
80 4 L A               Choose the download folder: browse the card, press A there.
80 4 L C               Switch between 40 and 80 columns.
80 4 L ESC             Back to the Explorer list.   F1 / F2   Flash / microSD list.
80 4 H Detail screen
80 4 L ENTER / SPACE   Download the file into the download folder (root by default).
80 4 L A               Choose the download folder (shown on this screen).
80 4 L ESC             Back to the result list.
80 4 L Open the F2 list afterwards to run what you downloaded.
80 5 H About Explorer
80 5 L PicoVerse 2350 Explorer for MSX, by Cristiano Goncalves (The Retro Hacker).
80 5 L Project: https://github.com/cristianoag/msx-picoverse-public
80 5 H If something goes wrong
80 5 L - No microSD card: reseat it. FAT16, FAT32 and exFAT cards are supported.
80 5 L - A game does not start: try another mapper or audio option on the ROM screen.
80 5 L - Unknown mapper: add a tag to the file name, for example Game.PLA-32.ROM.
80 5 L - Odd options or sound: delete the NAME.PVC file next to the ROM.
80 5 L - File Hunter offline: set the WiFi network again with F4.
80 5 L - More details are in the Explorer manual, in the docs folder of the project.
